components.name: Episode Tile
components.description: A compact tabular-number control for the dense episode grid.
components.css: .ds-episode-tile { width: 52px; padding: 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: #343a40; color: #fff; font: 400 16px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: color 100ms ease-in-out, background-color 100ms ease-in-out; } .ds-episode-tile:hover { color: rgb(83, 255, 134); } .ds-episode-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Selected Episode Tile
components.description: The unambiguous green selected state in the episode grid.
components.css: .ds-episode-selected { width: 52px; padding: 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(83, 255, 134); color: #101412; font: 400 16px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; } .ds-episode-selected:hover { filter: brightness(0.94); } .ds-episode-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-episode-selected:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Server Chip
components.description: A compact local-selection chip; its label carries no provider or playback promise.
components.css: .ds-server-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: #343a40; color: #fff; font: 400 13px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 100ms ease-in-out, background-color 100ms ease-in-out; } .ds-server-chip:hover { color: rgb(83, 255, 134); } .ds-server-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-server-chip:active, .ds-server-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgb(83, 255, 134); color: #101412; }

components.name: Player Preview Shell
components.description: An inert visual player composition with atmospheric art, focal marker, and utility chrome.
components.html: ▶00:00 / 24:00CC
components.css: .ds-player-shell { position: relative; width: min(720px, 100%); aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; color: #fff; background: radial-gradient(circle at 68% 34%, rgba(83, 255, 134, 0.15), transparent 27%), linear-gradient(rgba(4, 5, 7, 0.83), rgba(4, 5, 7, 0.83)), linear-gradient(135deg, #343a40, #181a1d); font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; } .ds-player-medallion { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 72px; height: 72px; display: grid; place-items: center; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; color: #111512; background: rgb(83, 255, 134); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); } .ds-player-medallion svg { margin-left: 4px; } .ds-player-controls { position: absolute; right: 18px; bottom: 14px; left: 18px; } .ds-player-track { height: 4px; margin-bottom: 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } .ds-player-track span { display: block; width: 8%; height: 100%; background: rgb(83, 255, 134); } .ds-player-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-player-row b { margin-left: auto; font-size: 12px; } .ds-player-shell:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 580px) { .ds-player-shell { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; } .ds-player-medallion { width: 58px; height: 58px; } .ds-player-row { gap: 12px; } }

components.name: Description Toggle
components.description: A low-chrome inline disclosure control appended directly to body copy.
components.css: .ds-description-toggle { padding: 0 0 0 6px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: rgb(83, 255, 134); font: 400 14px 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-description-toggle:hover { color: #fff; } .ds-description-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Search
components.description: A compact capsule search field that can move into a full-width floating row.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; width: min(250px, 100%); height: 40px; color: rgb(83, 255, 134); font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 0 56px 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 50px; outline: 0; background: #343a40; color: rgb(83, 255, 134); font: inherit; transition: box-shadow 300ms ease-in-out; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; top: 11px; right: 20px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input:hover { background: #3d444b; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 5px #242428; }

components.name: Anime Card
components.description: A dense poster-led recommendation card with a compact slate metadata footer.

components.css: .ds-anime-card { width: 180px; overflow: hidden; background: #343a40; color: #fff; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; } .ds-anime-art { position: relative; height: 250px; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #343a40 8%, rgba(52, 58, 64, 0.76) 16%, rgba(52, 58, 64, 0.41) 24%, transparent 32%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 28%, rgba(83, 255, 134, 0.28), transparent 24%), linear-gradient(145deg, #67736b, #202428 62%); } .ds-anime-art::after { content: '▶'; position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; background: rgba(52, 58, 64, 0.49); color: #fff; font-size: 54px; opacity: 0; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transition: opacity 300ms ease-in-out; } .ds-anime-badge { position: absolute; z-index: 1; bottom: 10px; left: 10px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px; background: #ffdd95; color: #242428; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-anime-meta { display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 0 10px 10px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-anime-meta strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-anime-meta small { color: #aaa; } .ds-anime-card:hover .ds-anime-art::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-anime-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid rgb(83, 255, 134); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Ryovia Watch feels like a compact digital screening room: the frame is nearly black, the anime key art spills into the surrounding atmosphere as a deep blur, and a single saturated green behaves like a status lamp. The interface stays useful and dense instead of cinematic for its own sake; the current player region, episode grid, controls, and metadata remain immediately scannable.

The player leads the responsive experience. Supporting controls are terse, close to the content they affect, and built from familiar compact geometry. The player itself is an inert visual shell: its play glyph, progress track, timecode, server labels, and language labels communicate composition and state styling only, never playback availability, provider behavior, or a network contract.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal digital surfaces with minimal separation lines.
Saturated green reserved for active state, focus, and high-value emphasis.
Blurred key art used as atmosphere behind the primary viewing region.
Dense episode and utility controls with tabular numerals.
Player-first reflow from desktop rail layout to stacked mobile flow.
Compact Trebuchet typography that favors utility over editorial display.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green is the only system-wide status accent; do not introduce competing action colors.

rules.name: The Image Supplies Color Rule
rules.body: Poster art may create atmosphere, but UI chrome remains charcoal, white, and Signal Green.

rules.name: The Utility First Rule
rules.body: Keep controls and metadata compact; large typography belongs only to the current title and section hierarchy.

rules.name: The Player First Rule
rules.body: When horizontal space collapses, preserve the player before episode selection and supporting metadata.

rules.name: The Dense Rail Rule
rules.body: Episode numbers should remain compact, evenly packed, and vertically scrollable before becoming oversized controls.

rules.name: The Atmospheric Depth Rule
rules.body: Use image blur and tonal overlays for environmental depth; reserve explicit shadows for focal or fixed elements.

dos: Do use Signal Green only for selected, focused, progress, and high-value emphasis states.
Do let key art tint the atmosphere while protecting legibility with charcoal blur overlays.
Do preserve dense, tabular episode numbering and compact utility labels.
Do reorder to a player-first stacked flow on narrow screens.
Do describe player and server UI as a visual shell unless behavior is implemented in a separately defined scope.
donts: Don't imply streaming, provider, subtitle, dub, or playback behavior from this visual system alone.
Don't add gradients, accent colors, or decorative glow to interface chrome beyond imagery-derived atmosphere.
Don't inflate controls into spacious cards or replace the dense grid with oversized tiles.
Don't use heavy shadows across ordinary surfaces; keep depth tonal and image-led.
Don't introduce ornate display typography that competes with the compact utility hierarchy.
